_comment: chirp airband daemon defaults. Phase 4a defaults + Phase 4b 'sdr' block. 'sdr' is consulted only when CHIRP_SOURCE=sdr (or source='sdr' here). All keys are optional and can be overridden by the matching CHIRP_* env var. See chirp/config/README.md.

sdr._comment: SDR source defaults for airband. Production cutover (Phase 4d) targets the analog RSPduo serial 1809063632 with mode=MA tuner=1, matching rtl-airband-airband. center_freq_hz must be set to whichever sub-band chirp is currently scanning; with 1 Msps the LO must be retuned by an external scheduler to cover the full 121-385 MHz airband list.
